headline: Dick Allen's three-run homer walks off Cubs in 12th
recap: Tied 2-2 in the bottom of the 12th, Cookie Rojas led off with a single off Chicago reliever Bill Hands. John Briggs sacrificed him to second, and after Hands intentionally walked Tony Gonzalez, Dick Allen drove a pitch out of the park for a three-run home run -- his 20th of the season -- sending the Phillies to a 5-2 win over the Cubs.

Cubs starter Fergie Jenkins worked into the ninth, allowing a run in the sixth on Tony Taylor's RBI single and the tying run in the ninth on Gary Sutherland's RBI single, before departing after 8.1 innings having struck out seven. Phillies starter Rick Wise threw seven innings, also charged with both of Chicago's runs, which scored on RBI singles by Clarence Jones in the fourth and Adolfo Phillips in the sixth.

Neither bullpen allowed a run in extra innings until Allen's homer ended it. Turk Farrell worked the eighth and ninth for Philadelphia, and Dick Hall followed with three scoreless innings to pick up the win; Chicago's Bill Stoneman threw 2.2 scoreless innings before Hands was charged with the loss.
